note: First live-play prototype. Targets retuned by player count (fairness analysis, 31 Oct). Strips list values for 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 players.

top.name: The First Crossing
top.text: Tiles on both banks, joined by a Bridge. Each crossing needs its own Bridge.

bottom.name: The River Kept Calm
bottom.text: Tiles beside River/Water may not be Overstrained beyond the limit, at any time.

top.name: No Hearth Stands Alone
top.text: Housing tiles, each beside another Housing tile.

bottom.name: No Cold Hearth
bottom.text: Housing tiles may not be Overstrained beyond the limit, at any time.

top.name: Corners of the Vale
top.text: Tiles on the corner hexes A1, A9, N1 and N9.

bottom.name: The Borders Held
bottom.text: Tiles on edge hexes may not be Overstrained beyond the limit, at any time.

top.name: A Settlement of Many Hands
top.text: Tiles in different tile categories.

bottom.name: Patchwork
bottom.text: Never place a tile beside another of its own category. Housing, Travel and Resource tiles are exempt.

top.name: Lands Remembered
top.text: Tiles on different terrains, not counting River/Water.

bottom.name: The Whole Vale
bottom.text: At the end, all at once: tiles on corners and on different terrains, and both banks joined by a Bridge.

top.name: The Home Farms
top.text: Farmsteads, each beside a Housing tile.

bottom.name: The Four Storehouses
bottom.text: Copies of each of Lumber Yard, Mine Tunnel, Gathering Outpost and Farmstead.

top.name: The Mine Road
top.text: Mine Tunnels, each beside a Travel tile.

bottom.name: The Resource Crown
bottom.text: Kinds of Resource tile with two copies placed, both upgraded.

top.name: The Fair Day
top.text: Merchant tiles, each beside a Housing, a Social and a Travel tile.

bottom.name: The Heart of the Vale
bottom.text: One tile ringed by six tiles, the seven in different categories. At 4 to 5 players, none of the seven may hold Strain.

top.name: Shelter and Song
top.text: A connected Housing cluster beside both a Social and a Wellbeing tile.

bottom.name: One Great Hearth
bottom.text: One connected cluster of Housing tiles.

top.name: The Care Ring
top.text: A Wellbeing tile ringed by six tiles, at least 4 of them Housing, Social or Wellbeing.

bottom.name: Garden Community
bottom.text: A Common Land ringed by Housing tiles. At 4 to 5 players, none of the seven may hold Strain.

top.name: The Quiet Courtyard
top.text: Six tiles ringed round an empty hex, in at least 4 categories.

bottom.name: The Ring Road
bottom.text: A closed loop of Travel tiles with other tiles inside it.

top.name: Mended Before Nightfall
top.text: In a single round, remove Strain from tiles in at least 2 categories (any tiles when solo).

bottom.name: The Vale Bent, Not Broke
bottom.text: Have Overstrained tiles at the same time, then end the game with none.

top.name: Sheltered District
top.text: Supported tiles across at least 3 categories (2 when solo).

bottom.name: Not One Lost
bottom.text: Tiles may not be Overstrained beyond the limit, at any time.

top.name: Good Work Made Last
top.text: Upgrade tiles.

bottom.name: No Fine Work
bottom.text: Never upgrade a Core tile, by any means.

top.name: Work and Rest
top.text: A Washhouse beside a Crafting, a Merchant and a Social tile, and also a Housing tile at 4 to 5 players.

bottom.name: The Unbroken Vale
bottom.text: Tiles holding 2 or more Strain may not exceed the limit, at any time.

top.name: The Market Track
top.text: Workshops and Market Stalls, all beside the same Track.

bottom.name: No Roads Raised
bottom.text: Never place a Travel tile, by any means. Common Land counts as Travel.

top.name: The Crossroads
top.text: A Travel tile beside three other Travel tiles and a Merchant tile.

bottom.name: The Long Road
bottom.text: One connected line of Travel tiles joining the rows shown. At 4 to 5 players it must also join column A to column N.

top.name: The River Is Welcomed
top.text: Housing, Merchant, Social and Wellbeing tiles beside River/Water, one of each kind.

bottom.name: Twin Villages
bottom.text: On each bank, a Housing cluster beside a Social tile, with the banks joined by a Bridge.

top.name: Hearths in Every Land
top.text: Housing tiles on different terrains, not counting Grasslands.

bottom.name: One Village
bottom.text: Every Housing tile must join the one Housing cluster when it is placed.

top.name: Bread, Stone and Timber
top.text: Lumber Yard, Mine Tunnel and Farmstead, all beside one connected Travel group, and also a Gathering Outpost at 4 to 5 players.

bottom.name: No Road Through
bottom.text: No Travel tile may ever be beside a Housing tile.

top.name: Stone over Running Water
top.text: Bridges placed, at least one upgraded to Stone Bridge.

bottom.name: Clean Slate
bottom.text: End the game with no more than this much Strain on the map.
